description: This PHP source file generates an HTML page for the first step of a Gateway Home Network Wizard. It includes form fields for changing the administrative password, incorporates validation and toggle features via JavaScript, and references external includes for header, footer, and other components.

methods.name: getInstanceNum
methods.description: Determines user instance number based on session login user.

methods.name: set_config
methods.description: Sends configuration data via AJAX to server-side handler and processes the response.

methods.name: next_step
methods.description: Validates password inputs and initiates password change process.
